EasterEggTip.SourceString:
【喜欢的食物】
薯条！大份薯条！刚炸出来、冒着热气的薯条！
“这是给我吃的吗？”星绘疑惑地举起手中的星芒咖啡：“咖啡配薯条好像有点奇怪？”
我将捧着大份薯条的手悬停在半空，故意装作石化的样子。
“那我们来交换吧！”星绘把星芒咖啡递给了我，笑着说道：“听说附近售卖的薯条特别受欢迎，前辈排队排了很久吧？谢谢你！”
星绘，果然是一个善解人意的小天使啊。
EasterEggTip.LocalizedString:
[Favorite Food]
Fries! A large order of hot, steamy fries just out of the fryer!
"Are these for me?" Celestia asked, a bit puzzled, holding up her Starlight Coffee. "Coffee with fries seems a bit odd?"
I hold the large fries suspended in mid-air, pretending to have turned to stone.
"Let's swap then!" Celestia offered her Starbeam Coffee to me with a smile, saying, "I heard the fries sold nearby are super popular. You must've waited in line for quite a while. Thank you!"
Celestia truly is a little angel who understands others so well.

EasterEggTip.SourceString:
【飞起来了！】
“如果载具行驶的速度足够快，就存在升空的可能。”蕾欧娜目光炯炯，看着停在岸边的摩托艇：“引航者，我打算试试！”
“不愧是工程部部长，如此具有实践精神……注意安全！”
蕾欧娜坚定地走向了摩托艇。说时迟那时快，一只海鸥从远处飞来，伴随着桀桀怪笑，趁蕾欧娜不注意，直接叼起她飞上了天空！
我揉揉眼，我大白天出现幻觉了？
“引航者，我真的飞起来了——”蕾欧娜兴奋的声音遥遥传来，我仰头望去，天空中只剩下渐渐远去的黑点。
EasterEggTip.LocalizedString:
[Taking Off!]
"If a vehicle moves fast enough, it can actually lift off the ground." Leona’s eyes sparkled as she looked at the jet ski parked at the shoreline. "Navigator, I'm going to give it a shot!"
"Spoken like a true head of the Engineering Department... just be careful out there!"
With steadfast determination, Leona headed for the jet ski. But just then, a seagull swooped in with an eerie chuckle, and before she knew it, lifted her into the sky!
I rubbed my eyes. Was I seeing things in the middle of the day?
"Navigator, I'm really flying!" Leona's excited voice echoed from above. I looked up to see nothing but a distant speck fading into the sky.

EasterEggTip.SourceString:
【解压玩具】
“对不起！下次绝对不会这样了！”白墨双手合十，向我和千代道歉。星绘则深深叹气：“白墨先生，嘱咐过你很多次了，请看清场合再社交。”
“无妨，小事而已。”尽管难掩失落，千代还是露出礼貌的笑容。
“啊哈哈哈，幸好只是照片没拍到，冠军起码拿到了！”结果下一秒，白墨开始顺杆爬。
不好！我注意了气氛的诡异变化，白墨真是哪壶不开提哪壶！
果然，虽然千代还保持着笑容，但额角已有青筋在跳动：“白墨阁下，我有必要纠正您的说法。欸……？”
她惊讶地看着被我塞进掌心的小黄鸭。小鸭软软胖胖，被挤压时肚子和两腮都会鼓起来，滑稽又可爱。
“这是？”
“捏捏乐。”我小声说道：“生气的话就捏捏它吧！等会领奖的时候，我一定会给你拍出完美的照片。”
EasterEggTip.LocalizedString:
[Stress Relief Toy]
"I'm really sorry! It won't happen again!" Bai Mo clasped his hands together, apologizing to both Chiyo and me. Celestia sighed deeply, "Mr. Bai, I've reminded you countless times—please consider the time and place before making your grand entrances."
"Don't worry about it, it's not a big deal." Despite her evident disappointment, Chiyo managed a polite smile.
"Haha, well, even if the pictures were a bust, you still clinched the championship!" Bai Mo tried to lighten the mood.
Uh-oh! I sensed an awkward shift in the atmosphere—Bai Mo had an uncanny knack for mentioning the wrong things at the wrong time!
As expected, even though Chiyo kept smiling, a vein started twitching at her temple. "Mr. Bai, I feel I must correct your—huh...?"
She paused, surprised as I pressed a small rubber duck into her hand. The duck was soft and plump, with a belly and cheeks that puffed out humorously when squeezed.
"What’s this?"
"It's a stress squishy," I whispered. "If you feel mad, just give it a squeeze! I promise I'll snap the perfect photo when it's time for your award."

EasterEggTip.SourceString:
【殊途同归】
“刚刚的照片都拍到了吧？”训练结束，白墨抱着冲浪板兴奋地向我跑来。
“拍到了。看！你的起乘，你的转弯，你的抛板，你的摔倒……”我滑动屏幕，一张张给白墨展示着。
看到几张糗照，白墨慌乱起来，一把夺走我的相机快步拉开距离：“辛苦你了，有一些照片是可以删的，我来帮你选！”
“等等，白墨，”我举起手，试图阻止他的离开，但白墨铁了心维护自己盟主的颜面，他甚至单手捂住了耳朵。
“地上有——”西瓜皮……
来不及了。一心逃避的乌尔比诺盟主已经踩着西瓜皮飞了出去，在人来人往的海滩上。这次，可不只有相机见证了。
EasterEggTip.LocalizedString:
[Paths Aligned]
"You got all those photos, right?" Bai Mo runs up to me excitedly, hugging his surfboard.
"I got them. Look! Here’s your takeoff, your turn, your board toss, and... your wipeout." I swipe through the screen, showing Bai Mo each shot.
Seeing a few embarrassing ones, Bai Mo panics and quickly snatches the camera from me, putting some distance between us. "You've done great—some of these can definitely be deleted. Let me help you with that!"
"Hold on, Bai Mo!" I raise my hand, trying to stop him from leaving. But he's determined to protect his reputation as a guild leader, even covering one ear with his hand.
"There's a—" Watermelon peel...
Too late. Completely focused on evading the situation, Urbino's leader takes a slip on the watermelon peel, sending him flying in the busy beach crowd. This time, it wasn’t just the camera that caught the moment.

EasterEggTip.SourceString:
【蝴蝶在看着你】
一阵夜风吹过，明明舒适宜人，却让米雪儿起了一身鸡皮疙瘩。她好像在泳池边的躺椅上，看见了一个人影！
“伙伴，你有没有觉得温度突然变低了？而且，有人在……盯着我们……啊啾！”米雪儿打了个喷嚏。
“没有啊，你别是游太久感冒了吧。要不然早点回去休息？”

果真没有吗……米雪儿披上毛巾，狐疑地看着四周。在她视线的盲区内，一只紫色的蝴蝶轻盈地绕着岸边吧台旋转了几圈，落在那本被翻开、一个字都没写的任务报告上。
EasterEggTip.LocalizedString:
[The Butterfly's Watching]
A gentle night breeze rustled by—nice and soothing, yet it sent a shiver through Michele, covering her in goosebumps. She thought she caught sight of a shadow on one of the poolside lounge chairs! "Hey partner, did you feel the temperature just drop? And...someone's watching us... Ah-choo!" Michele sneezed.
"Nope, didn't notice anything. Maybe you've been swimming too long and caught a chill. How about we head back and get some rest?"
Was it really nothing? Michele wrapped a towel around herself, casting a wary eye around. Just beyond her line of sight, a purple butterfly fluttered gracefully, making a few loops around the poolside bar before settling on an open mission report, its pages still blank.

EasterEggTip.SourceString:
【热闹是她们的，我也不想要】
“呃……”
那个总是胸有成竹、什么事情都无法让她惊讶的女人，第一次露出称得上‘无语’的表情。
梅瑞狄斯抱着手上的沙滩排球，默默移开了眼：“我也没想到，难得给自己放个假，居然就遇上乌尔比诺团建。”
“我已经尽力选择人少的时间出来练习了，但被谣传成夜晚的海滩幽灵什么的……”

加拉蒂亚实在没忍住，笑出了声。下一秒，她就看到平日里冷淡的学者有些窘迫地红了耳根，抱着排球，一副准备马上开溜的样子。
“好了我不笑了，你留下来陪我吧？”加拉蒂亚连忙伸出手挽留：“我可以陪你练习排球。”

纤细的手覆上来，梅瑞狄斯一惊，手里的排球掉落下来，在地上弹了两下。
海边漫步的火烈鸟遇见了新同伴，递出一枚示好的羽毛：“和你一样，热闹是她们的，我也不想要。”
“或许，我们能成为朋友？”
EasterEggTip.LocalizedString:
[The liveliness is theirs, and I’m not looking for it either.]
"Uh..."
That woman, always so composed and unflappable, finally showed an expression I’d describe as 'speechless.'
Meredith shifted her gaze, clutching the beach volleyball in her hands. "I never expected a rare break for myself would mean running into an Urbino team-building event."
"I tried to pick a quiet time to come out and practice, but somehow I've become the subject of rumors about a beach ghost haunting the night..."

Galatea couldn't help herself and burst into laughter. In the next second, she saw the typically aloof scholar's ears turn slightly pink in embarrassment, hugging the volleyball and looking ready to make a quick escape.
"Alright, I'll stop laughing. Won't you stay and keep me company?" Galatea quickly reached out to persuade her. "I can join you for volleyball practice."

Meredith flinched as a delicate hand touched hers, causing the volleyball to slip and bounce twice on the ground.
Like a flamingo finding a kindred spirit on the shore, offering a feather in a gesture of friendship. "Like you, the noise is all theirs—I’m not interested."
"Maybe we could be friends?"
